description: Phase 1 of the munin improvement plan: retrieval quality (hybrid dense+lexical search with RRF, multi-signal ranking, MMR diversity, ef_search/iterative-scan tuning) plus ingest embedding bug fixes. No new dependencies, no reindex. Includes a migration bootstrap script to fix the recurring 'migrations not applied' blocker.

userStories.title: Migration bootstrap script (scripts/migrate.sh)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single command that applies all sql/NNN_*.sql migrations in order against the running compose stack, so migrations are reliably applied before any verification or downstream story.
acceptanceCriteria: Running scripts/migrate.sh applies every sql/NNN_*.sql file in ascending numeric order against the Postgres container on port 5433
Re-running scripts/migrate.sh on an already-migrated database completes without error (idempotent or clearly skips already-applied migrations)
The script exits non-zero and prints the failing file name if any migration errors
After running, the thoughts table and existing RPC functions are present (verified via a psql information_schema query)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
knownIssues: Recurring blocker: DB migrations historically not applied before worker verification (retro alert, confirmed 2026-04-12..04-13)
psycopg_pool not always pre-installed in dev env; script should use psql/docker exec, not Python

userStories.title: Add lexical tsvector column + GIN index for hybrid search
userStories.description: As the retrieval layer, I need a full-text lexical representation of each thought so hybrid search can combine dense vectors with keyword matching.
acceptanceCriteria: A new migration sql/006_hybrid_search.sql adds a tsvector representation of thought content (generated/stored column) plus a GIN index
Existing rows are backfilled so every thought has a non-null tsvector after migration
The migration applies cleanly via scripts/migrate.sh against a database that already contains the current ~5k thoughts, with zero rows lost (row count before == row count after)
A plain to_tsquery lexical search for an exact token (e.g. a function name) returns the thought containing that token
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
knownIssues: Must be non-destructive: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN only, no data rewrite that risks existing embeddings

userStories.title: Rewrite match_thoughts: hybrid RRF + multi-signal ranking + ef tuning
userStories.description: As an agent calling recall, I want results ranked by fused dense+lexical relevance combined with recency and historical usefulness, so the most relevant and useful thoughts surface first.
acceptanceCriteria: match_thoughts fuses a dense (vector cosine) candidate list and a lexical (tsvector) candidate list using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k configurable, default ~60)
Final ordering applies a weighted multi-signal score combining fused relevance with recency (created_at/last_hit_at) and hit_count, with weights read from config (defaults documented)
The function sets hnsw.ef_search (default 100) and enables hnsw.iterative_scan via SET LOCAL within the query path
A recall query for an exact identifier returns the matching thought even when its embedding similarity alone would rank it outside top-k (hybrid wins over pure-cosine)
A frequently-hit recent thought ranks above an equally-similar stale, never-hit thought
Existing recall behaviour (project/scope filtering) is preserved; no thought from another project leaks into results
memory.py passes the raw query text (for lexical leg) and ranking weights through to the RPC
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
knownIssues: hit_count/last_hit_at columns already exist (sql/005) but were never read into ranking — this story activates them

userStories.title: MMR diversity re-ranking over hybrid candidates
userStories.description: As an agent calling recall, I want near-duplicate results suppressed so the top-k covers distinct information instead of paraphrases of one thought.
acceptanceCriteria: After fused ranking, a Maximal Marginal Relevance pass re-orders candidates trading relevance against diversity, with lambda configurable (default documented)
For a project containing several near-duplicate thoughts, the top-k returned contains distinct thoughts rather than multiple paraphrases of the same one
MMR can be disabled via config, and when disabled recall returns the pure fused ranking unchanged
Recall result count still respects the requested limit/k
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Fix ingest embedding: fingerprint-before-embed, batching, client reuse
userStories.description: As a developer ingesting content, I want unchanged content skipped before embedding and chunks embedded in batches over a reused HTTP client, so re-ingestion is fast and wasteful embed calls are eliminated.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-ingesting an unchanged source makes zero embedding HTTP calls (the unchanged-content fingerprint check runs before the embed call, not after)
A fresh ingest of multiple chunks sends batched embedding requests via embed_batch() rather than one HTTP POST per chunk
Embedding requests during a single ingest reuse one httpx client instead of opening a new client per call
Ingested thoughts are stored with correct embeddings (a recall for ingested content still returns it) — no regression in stored vectors
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
knownIssues: Current bug: ingest.py fingerprint/unchanged check runs AFTER embed (line ~171 vs ~210-216), so unchanged re-ingest re-embeds everything
embed_batch() exists but has zero production callers

userStories.title: Isolate test DB (munin_test) + TRUNCATE safety guard
userStories.description: Integration tests truncate the live munin DB. Create an isolated munin_test database and a hard guard so pytest can never wipe production memory.
acceptanceCriteria: A separate munin_test database exists in the same Postgres container with the full schema applied
scripts/migrate.sh accepts a target database via env (e.g. MUNIN_PG_DB, default munin) so it can migrate munin_test
tests/integration/conftest.py points MUNIN_DB_URL at munin_test; integration tests pass against it
Unit tests that perform real DB writes target munin_test, not munin (test_config default-URL assertions stay unchanged)
Hard guard: the truncate fixture refuses to TRUNCATE unless the connected database name is munin_test, raising an explicit error otherwise
A full pytest run leaves the production munin DB row count unchanged (still 4881)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
knownIssues: Root cause of data-loss incident: tests/integration/conftest.py autouse TRUNCATE ran against prod DB localhost:5433/munin
